bias.label: Leaning down below 3,800; holding 3,760-3,770 for now

event: FOMC minutes tonight, Wed 18 Nov, at 21:00 SAST. US housing starts today (time UNVERIFIED, usually 15:30 SAST).

bullets.title: Still under 3,800
bullets.text: Gold is about 3,766-3,771, down roughly 2.0-2.2% on the day and at its lowest since September 2025 (quote time UNVERIFIED, asof is approximate).

bullets.title: Support holding so far
bullets.text: Price is sitting on the 3,750-3,770 zone, which matches IG's monthly pivot support near 3,760.

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: December quarter-point hike odds are about 94-96%, and Fed speakers such as Musalem back more tightening.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is firm at about 103.77, and the 10-year yield is about 5.12%.

bullets.title: Oil and risk
bullets.text: Brent near 93 on Hormuz tension feeds inflation and hike fears more than safe-haven buying, and stocks are selling off.

bullets.title: Minutes tonight
bullets.text: The October FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can move gold fast in either direction.
